entities.name: Inys Nohr
entities.description: A settlement on Cridhe's northeastern coast, once a cursed fortress town and later the plane's largest city.

entities.name: Nohr
entities.description: The founder of Inys Nohr, whose fateful injury was mirrored by the Felonarchs.

entities.name: Felonarchs
entities.description: A line of rulers of Inys Nohr whose bloodline carried madness.

entities.name: Hankin
entities.description: The fifth Felonarch, who built the Tower at Inys Nohr.

entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: A Felonarch who raided Inys Haen to force the Awakening ritual and abandoned Inys Nohr.

entities.name: Inys Haen
entities.description: A place Nazir raided to force the Keeper to perform the Awakening ritual.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: The Keeper's daughter, brought back by Nazir's forces.

entities.name: Thix
entities.description: Nazir's kinsman, who died in internal conflict.

entities.name: Mirkalbions
entities.description: Outcasts mutated by dependence on ardre fungus, enslaved in Inys Nohr; they revolted.

entities.name: Albion Colony
entities.description: A colony in the hills north of Inys Nohr, disbanded after the Mending of the Clan Tree.

entities.name: Clan Tree of Cridhe
entities.description: The tree whose destruction cursed Inys Nohr with perpetual winter and whose Mending thawed the land.

entities.name: Mending of the Clan Tree
entities.description: The event after which the land thawed and Inys Nohr was rebuilt.

entities.name: Parting
entities.description: The event after which Nohr and his followers founded Inys Nohr.

events.summary: Nohr and his followers found Inys Nohr after the Parting; it becomes an isolated stronghold cursed with perpetual winter after the Clan Tree is destroyed.
events.quote: Founded by Nohr and his followers after the Parting

events.summary: Felonarch Nazir raids Inys Haen to force the Keeper to perform the Awakening ritual but returns only with the Keeper's daughter Aylith; Thix dies and RoNal is disgraced.
events.quote: Nazir's forces returned only with the Keeper's daughter, Aylith

events.summary: An uprising of the city's poor and enslaved mirkalbion breaks out while Nazir is away, and the Tower at Inys Nohr collapses.
events.quote: the mirkalbion revolt caused the Tower at Inys Nohr to collapse

events.summary: After the Mending of the Clan Tree the land thaws and Inys Nohr is rebuilt into the largest city on Cridhe.
events.quote: the land thawed for the first time in generations

relations.note: built the Tower at Inys Nohr
relations.quote: The Tower at Inys Nohr was built by fifth Felonarch Hankin
the city was ruled by a line of Felonarchs
Founded by Nohr and his followers after the Parting
Inys Nohr is a settlement on Cridhe
